_readme: “My print didn’t come out” fix cards, in the order they appear. Each has a phone page at its url.

lost.label: My job isn’t at the release station
lost.title: Can’t find your print? That happens. Let’s find it.
lost.cause: Your job may have gone to a different printer, or it was cleared after waiting [[how long jobs are held|2 hours]].
lost.say: “My print job isn’t at the release station.”
steps: At the release station, log in with the same card or guest pass you used at the computer.
Check the other release screen too [[B&W vs. color stations|— color jobs go to the second screen on the right]].
If it’s been longer than [[how long jobs are held|2 hours]], print it again from the computer.

money.label: It says I don’t have enough money
money.title: There isn’t enough on your card for this print. Here’s how to add more.
money.cause: Prints are paid at the release station from [[card balance / payment method|your print account]].
money.say: “The release station says I don’t have enough money.”
steps: Add money at [[add-value station or desk|the add-value machine beside the release station]].
You can pay with [[accepted payment|cash, coins, or a debit or credit card]].
Go back to the release station. Your job is still waiting.

wrong.label: It printed the wrong thing, wrong size, or cut off
wrong.title: Your print came out wrong. A setting usually fixes it.
wrong.cause: The print window picked the wrong pages, paper size, or scale.
wrong.say: “My print came out cut off or the wrong size.”
steps: At the computer, open Print again and check the pages you want.
Set paper to Letter and choose “Fit to page.”
Ask staff about the misprint [[misprint refund policy|— staff can credit pages a printer jam ruined]].

card.label: My card or guest pass doesn’t work
card.title: Your card or guest pass may need a quick check.
card.cause: The number may be mistyped, or the pass may have expired [[guest pass rule|— guest passes last one day]].
card.say: “My card or guest pass isn’t working for printing.”
steps: Type the number on the back of your card, with no spaces.
Guest passes last [[how long guest passes last|one day]]. Staff can make a new one.
Staff at the desk can check your card.

phone.label: I can’t print from my phone
phone.title: Printing from your phone works a little differently here.
phone.cause: [[supported phone printing options|Direct phone printing isn’t set up here yet]]. If there’s no direct option, email always works.
phone.say: “I’m trying to print from my phone.”
steps: Email the file to yourself from your phone.
Log in at any patron computer and open your email.
Print it there, then release it at the release station.

releaseCard.t: Log in here with the same card or guest pass you used at the computer. Jobs wait [[how long jobs are held|2 hours]].
Add more at [[add-value station or desk|the add-value machine beside this screen]]. Your job keeps waiting.
Print again from the computer with paper set to Letter and “Fit to page.”
